action.command: echo "=== top-level modules link check ==="; ls -la /workspace/app/node_modules/ | grep -v "^d" | head; echo "(no top-level symlinks means install incomplete)"; echo "=== .pnpm lock/state files ==="; ls -la /workspace/app/node_modules/.pnpm/lock.yaml 2>&1; ls /workspace/app/node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules 2>&1 | head; echo "=== try pnpm install offline dry ==="; cd /workspace/app && timeout 60 pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== top-level modules link check ===\"; ls -la /workspace/app/node_modules/ | grep -v \"^d\" | head; echo \"(no top-level symlinks means install incomplete)\"; echo \"=== .pnpm lock/state files ===\"; ls -la /workspace/app/node_modules/.pnpm/lock.yaml 2>&1; ls /workspace/app/node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules 2>&1 | head; echo \"=== try pnpm install offline dry ===\"; cd /workspace/app && timeout 60 pnpm install --offline --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tail -15; echo \"EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}\"", "summary": "Confirm incomplete node_modules layout"}
